en: Dependent on a state that is non-conflict (*anāsava*), non-root, and not accompanied by a root, there arises a state that is non-conflict, non-root, and accompanied by a root, by way of root-condition. (Abbreviated. One [condition] under root; ... pe ... one under non-disappearance.

Dependent on a state that is non-conflict, non-root, and not accompanied by a root, there arises a state that is non-conflict, non-root, and not accompanied by a root, by way of root-condition; ... one.
Dependent on a state that is non-conflict, non-root, and not accompanied by a root, there arises a state that is non-conflict, non-root, and not accompanied by a root.
Conditioned by root-condition: ... one. (Abbreviated. Under root there are two; under predominance there are two ...
mutual condition, one ... resultant condition, one ... non-disappearance condition, two.
